086FD9D0.name: Smoke puff
086FD9D0.notes: generic effect 0x0802A81C, 4 records, rate 0x1000 + rand(0x1000) at most sites

08712FDC.name: Explosion
08712FDC.notes: generic effect 0x0802A81C, 4 records; rate 0x2000 (projectiles) or 0x1000 + rand(0x1000) (0x0801952C: deaths, Big Bang, Dragon Fist, beams)

0871370C.name: Energy Blast
0871370C.notes: ki blast 0x080197B4 (player and enemies): records dir*4 + f (f = t >> 3, then 2/3), record 16 = spark shown 16 ticks at a wall / hit

0871E630.name: Tank shell
0871E630.notes: class 0x0801C900: records 0-3 by direction, 4-6 smoke trail (rate 0x2AAA every 4 ticks)

087202E8.name: Energy shield
087202E8.notes: R+B shield 0x0801DFE0: record = c >> 3 (grow 0-2, loop 3-6, shrink), drawn on even ticks

08721164.name: Beam charge sparkles
08721164.notes: state-0 sparkle of the beam object: 0-2 Kamekameha, 3-5 Kamehameha / Electric / Big Bang Kamehameha, 6-8 Banshee Blast, 9-11 Masenkoha Lv1-2, 12-14 Lv3 beams / Masenkoha Lv3 / Flame Kamehameha / Super Buu ball

0872A5DC.name: Masenkoha blast
0872A5DC.notes: Lv1 records 0-3, Lv2 4-8, Lv3 / Super Buu ball 9-14; 4 ticks each

0872BF04.name: Instant Transmission markers
0872BF04.notes: groups of 4 (rec = group + ((t >> 2) & 3)): 0-3 cursor, 4-7 target, 8-11 unused; drawn twice (normal + vertically flipped) as a 32x32 ring

0872D6C4.name: Flame (down)
0872D6C4.notes: records 1-4 of the down flame; full table fx_0872d6b8

0872D700.name: Flame (up)
0872D700.notes: records 1-4 of the up flame; full table fx_0872d6b8

0872D73C.name: Flame (left)
0872D73C.notes: records 1-4 of the left flame; full table fx_0872d6b8

0872D778.name: Flame (right)
0872D778.notes: records 1-4 of the right flame; full table fx_0872d6b8

0874E614.name: Rifle bullet
0874E614.notes: class 0x080276A8 (Hessian, Marauder, Mercenary): records 0-3 by direction, 4-6 smoke trail

0874E968.name: Gun bullet
0874E968.notes: class 0x080274B4 (Assassin, Gunman, Sniper): record dir + 4f, f = 0,1,2,1 every 4 ticks

0874ED7C.name: Candy beam
0874ED7C.notes: Majin Buu 0x080286D4: 5 records per direction (muzzle 0/1, body 2, head 3/4)

0874EFEC.name: Stretch arm
0874EFEC.notes: Majin Buu / Super Buu 0x08028C04: 2 records per direction (arm, fist)

087501EC.name: Burning Attack
087501EC.notes: class 0x08029384: records (t >> 3) & 1 in flight, 2/3 at the end (16 ticks)

0875043C.name: Energy wave
0875043C.notes: enemy wave 0x0802A2EC: 3 records per direction (muzzle 0/1, body 2)

087520D4.name: Super Saiyan swirl
087520D4.notes: transform effect when script flag 0x03002BB0 is set: 7 records, rate 0xC88

08752D28.name: Super Saiyan aura
08752D28.notes: transform aura: 3 records looping at rate 0x4000

087616EC.name: Final Flash
087616EC.notes: class 0x08036FA2 table 2 (player Lv3, Majin Vegeta, Yakon)

08762270.name: Energy Punch aura
08762270.notes: Energy Punch Lv3 record object: 3 records per direction

0876AAE0.name: Big Bang ball (Lv3)
0876AAE0.notes: ball 0x08037480 Lv3: record dir*10 + f (7..9 cycling)

0876DFF8.name: Grapple arm
0876DFF8.notes: Bio Mech 0x08037EA8: 4 records per direction (chain, open hand, closed back / front)

0876E264.name: Ultra Volleyball Attack wave
0876E264.notes: class 0x080383D4: 3 records per direction (tail, body, head)

0877AD10.name: Dragon Fist Explosion
0877AD10.notes: segment chain 0x08038AD8: 4 records per direction (body, head, head dying 2-3)

0877B4F8.name: Red beam charge
0877B4F8.notes: charge sparkles of the red story beam 0x0877C41C
